title: Modify an existing component
note: Exercises SEARCH/REPLACE against a file the runner did load. A SEARCH miss here means the model paraphrased content it could see.
prompt: Add an optional prop `excited` (boolean, default false) to src/components/HelloWorld.vue. When it is true the greeting ends with an exclamation mark instead of nothing. Do not change anything else about the component.
guard_note: Assertions flagged `guard` are regression checks — they hold on the untouched seed and exist to catch a model that rewrites the file and drops existing content. They are scored separately from task assertions.
